title: Lorekeeper ADR findings, v1
description: What a reviewer reports after checking a diff against the records `adr-lint select --json` returns. Validated by `adr-lint verdict --findings <file> --diff <patch>`.

checked.description: Every record id you read in full against the diff; must include every selected candidate whose status is not `missing`.

notReviewed.description: Areas of the diff you could not assess, and why. Reported, not judged.

ids.description: One record: its id, its rules (<id>.R<n>) or facts (<id>.F<n>); [] for uncovered; the cited id for dangling.

where.description: path:line-range of the change; null only for dangling.

summary.description: One line. trigger: name the trigger and what fires it. uncovered: what reversing the choice would take.
